editorial/response_body.tex:
The two broader registered empirical families are also complete. The five-method continuation menu retains all 128 trials, 640 method fits, 216 primary events, and 128 scalar statements. The strengthened-HJB study retains four economic designs, 64 trials, 320 policies, and 648 events. Their inclusion changes this from a design-only response into an outcome-level comparison. NBO has material advantages over fitted alternatives in difficult reusable-continuation cases and practical equivalence with cached sample-average optimization at lower construction and query work in six of eight final-stage cases. The sample-average method wins materially in both long-continuation cases, and strengthening HJB leaves most direct contrasts unresolved. All outcomes, not only favorable signs, enter the revised article and complete supplement.
The completed nonlinear comparison is presented in Section~\ref{sec:r16completedmenu}, with its design and every registered outcome in Appendix~\ref{app:r16registered}. A vector costate fit, cached Raw actor, task-conditioned direct actor, and Raw sample-average optimizer receive legitimate reuse as well. All stages and all declared economic designs are retained. The fixed-dictionary proposition gives a proved economic mechanism; the nonlinear outcomes are independently evaluated rather than identified with that proposition.
\paragraph*{Completed evidence and scope.} The original and fresh-bank NBO--Raw intervals remain visible and unresolved. A Raw method applying the same projection has the same estimator and does not lose merely because its name is Raw. The complete menu now supplies a direct incremental comparison. In the long fifty-dimensional case, the NBO advantage over the vector costate, Raw actor, and direct actor has lower endpoints 16.38, 18.02, and 3.27 in units of $10^{-4}$. The untouched intermediate fifty-dimensional case also yields material Raw-actor and direct-actor advantages. Across all 24 registered stage--economy cases, the numbers of positive lower endpoints against vector, Raw actor, direct actor, and cached sample-average optimization are 22, 19, 16, and zero. Practical equivalence with the sample-average method holds in six of eight final-stage cases at the fixed margin, while the two long cases show material inferiority. These results identify a scoped economic tradeoff rather than necessity of a critic in every implementation.
\paragraph*{Completed evidence and scope.} The current original and replicated superiority statements are expressly limited to the original specified HJB implementation. They are not relabeled as evidence against the strengthened family. The strengthened family is now evaluated completely in Section~\ref{sec:r16completedrobust}. The low-volatility fifty-dimensional NBO-minus-greedy and NBO-minus-distilled intervals are contained in $[0.000334,0.000697]$ and $[0.000340,0.000704]$. The other fourteen HJB contrasts include zero. In particular, the enlarged family substantially narrows the original comparator gap; its point-estimate reversals are retained, not hidden. All four candidate fits, independent residual diagnostics, both deployments, and complete work remain in the evidence tree. Sampled residuals and successive-iterate differences are not called uniform HJB error certificates.
The common-continuation section adds a transparent amortization calculation. A lower per-task cost repays additional shared fitting work only beyond its explicit break-even task count. This is an accounting implication, not a proof of economic noninferiority. The completed menu measures construction, deployment, optimization, and the full shared confirmation bundle for all five methods and every stage. NBO has lower observed complete third-stage construction and query work than cached sample-average optimization in all eight cases and satisfies the prespecified practical-equivalence criterion in six. For the quarterly and untouched intermediate fifty-dimensional cases, the construction/query clocks are 14.34 versus 62.90 seconds and 12.70 versus 79.46 seconds. Both long cases instead have material sample-average payoff advantages. Raw actors remain cheaper than NBO. The shared confirmation bundle is retained separately and can be charged in full to either method; it is not divided into fictional standalone costs. Consequently the claim is a measured work--accuracy tradeoff, not universal dominance or an invented work-to-certified-gain stopping time.
The continuation-menu design independently includes the original low-volatility anchor, the disclosed reuse pilot, a longer unpiloted continuation, and untouched intermediate primitives. The protocol retains all four designs and all work stages, rather than selecting the design with the most favorable final comparison. The completed results in this edition do not silently substitute seed variation for economic variation. The complete outcome-level robustness family is now included: all eight NBO gain intervals have positive lower endpoints, while the Raw contrasts and most strengthened-HJB contrasts remain unresolved. The menu likewise retains all four designs, including the untouched intermediate case, all 1,920 stage candidates, and every unfavorable comparison. These are genuine variations in economic primitives, reported separately; the estimands still do not extrapolate to an unobserved universal optimizer distribution.
Proposition~\ref{prop:r16menugap} adds a different absolute accuracy object. Its variation bounds give global curvature on an entire prespecified scalar intervention segment. An independent derivative interval then bounds the best action over every point of that segment, including unevaluated points. The support formula remains valid when the strong-concavity coefficient is nonpositive. The derivative interval is derived from a protected paired secant and its deterministic curvature allowance, not from treating an automatic derivative as an exact expectation. The completed scalar assessment now supplies numerical whole-segment accuracy, not only a route to it. Eighty of the 128 prespecified candidates meet the $10^{-4}$ margin, including every quarterly fifty-dimensional stream with upward-rounded gap bounds no larger than $0.0000141$. All forty-eight nonattainments remain displayed; the largest long fifty-dimensional bound is $0.1963168$. The protected secant and curvature are unchanged from their pre-confirmation specification. This is not mislabeled as a full adapted-control or continuous-time guarantee.
The new confidence allocation has four disjoint named budgets totaling $0.05$ by a union bound. No unused allocation is recycled, and historical families are not silently included in this new union. The reproduction record provides each family's distinct source, outcome status, and estimand. All four named registered families are now complete. The publication record binds each to its distinct pre-confirmation source and immutable result tree. This establishes the chronology of the executed studies without making any claim about every possible unregistered economic or optimizer population.
The substantive completed changes are the signed positive occupation mechanism, prospective paired replication, decision-value theorem, protected conditional comparison and scalar-accuracy theory, full five-method continuation evidence, full strengthened-HJB cross-calibration evidence, and the reorganized article and supplement. Every one of the four registered evidence families is complete. The conditional Raw, work--accuracy, scalar, and HJB conclusions now rest on the complete outcomes rather than plans. Unresolved comparisons and broad full-adapted-control gap bounds remain honestly stated; they do not erase the positive economic mechanisms and scoped performance findings. Editorial acceptance and universal superiority are not presumed.
